sloka: सुभृशं श्लाघनीयं च यदुक्तं भरत त्वया ।वचनं भ्रातृवात्सल्यादनुरूपं तवैव तत् ॥ २.११५.५॥
transliteration: subhṛśaṁ ślāghanīyaṁ ca yaduktaṁ bharata tvayā ।vacanaṁ bhrātṛvātsalyādanurūpaṁ tavaiva tat ॥ 2.115.5॥

translations.english: O Bharata, the words you have uttered out of devotion to your brother which befit you alone are highly praiseworthy.
